title: More apps list
description: List of apps shown on the More screen. Categories become tabs, in order of first appearance.

name.description: App name shown on the card.

category.description: Tab this app appears under, e.g. Widgets, Icons, Wallpapers. Omit for 'More'. Case-sensitive, no leading/trailing spaces.

description.description: One-line summary (shown on one line, truncated with an ellipsis).

play_store_url.description: Play Store link of the app.

images.description: Screenshot URLs (https). The card swipes through them.
